name: Fashion & Apparel
description: Clothing, shoes and accessories from high-street names and online fashion retailers. Sales move fast, so check expiry dates before checkout.

name: Electronics & Tech
description: Phones, laptops, TVs and gadgets. Big-ticket items carry the biggest savings but the strictest exclusions, so read each offer terms.

name: Health & Beauty
description: Makeup, skincare, haircare and wellness. Beauty codes often stack with loyalty points, free gifts and member-only sales.

name: Home & Garden
description: Furniture, decor, DIY and garden essentials. Seasonal sales and clearance events bring the deepest discounts here.

name: Travel & Hotels
description: Flights, hotels, holiday rentals and car hire. Booking windows and member rates often beat the headline code.

name: Food Delivery
description: Restaurant delivery and takeaway apps. First-order codes and free-delivery thresholds are where the real savings sit.

name: Groceries & Supermarkets
description: Supermarket codes, delivery passes and cashback on weekly shops. Compare the final basket, not just the headline percentage.

name: Software & SaaS
description: VPNs, hosting, design and productivity tools. Most discounts apply to the first term only, so note the renewal price.

name: Sports & Outdoors
description: Running, training and outdoor gear. Student and member programmes often beat public promo codes.

name: Gaming & Consoles
description: Games, consoles, subscriptions and in-game credit. Digital store sales rotate weekly, so wishlist before you buy.

name: Baby & Kids
description: Nursery, pushchairs, kids clothing and toys. Bundle offers and new-customer codes add up for growing families.

name: Furniture & Decor
description: Sofas, beds, storage and home decor. Lead times and clearance timing matter as much as the discount.

name: Pets
description: Pet food, supplies and pharmacy items. Subscribe-and-save usually beats a one-off coupon on repeat buys.

name: Automotive
description: Car parts, servicing, tyres and accessories. Seasonal fitting offers and rebate cards are common here.

name: DIY & Tools
description: Tools, hardware, paint and building supplies. Trade accounts and bulk pricing often beat public codes.

name: Jewellery & Watches
description: Rings, necklaces, watches and gifts. Engraving and gift-wrap offers can be as valuable as the discount.

name: Tickets & Entertainment
description: Concerts, theatre, cinema and events. Presales and member windows matter more than coupon codes.

name: Courses & Learning
description: Online courses, e-learning and skills platforms. Frequent sitewide sales make timing your purchase worthwhile.
